greeting.title: Greetings
greeting.html:
We design the power for local communities to recover on their own and leave that system within the region.

Urban Community Center (UCC) is a convergence platform and implementation organization for urban, community, and resilience, established to innovate social economy governance in marginalized areas facing the crises of population decline and regional extinction.

We accompany the field directly from diagnosis to self-reliance and transition. We create working solutions through Living Lab-based verification, cultivate residents and activists into policy producers and experts, and stand with them through consulting, platforms, and networks until the region can stand on its own.

Urban Community Center will continue to foster healthy communities based on the values of solidarity, reciprocity, democratic operation, and a local circular economy, and we will grow into a think tank specializing in urban innovation and community that represents the Republic of Korea by 2030. We ask for your interest and participation.

Dr. Ga-hee Lee, Chairperson of Urban Community Center (UCC)

vision.title: Vision and Goals
vision.html:
MISSION

We build an urban and community innovation platform that provides direct solutions, education, and services to innovate social economy governance in marginalized areas.

VISION

By 2030, we aim to establish ourselves as South Korea's leading think tank and implementation organization specializing in urban innovation and community development.

Core Values

  • SUSTAINABILITY
  • INNOVATION
  • SOLIDARITY
  • EXPERTISE
  • RESILIENCE

3-Year Goals (2028)

  • 130 full members → 10,000 members
  • Expand to 20 member companies
  • 50,000 participants in education programs
  • Establish 5–7 living lab demonstration sites by type and train 100 Regional Recovery Change-makers (RRC)

esg.title: ESG Management
esg.html:
Based on the values pursued by the "Framework Act on Social Solidarity Economy," we contribute to resolving polarization, responding to local extinction, and fostering healthy communities.

Environmental

We enhance environmental sustainability through the development of sustainable city standards and certification systems, as well as urban resilience diagnostics.

Social

We build communities centered on social values through solidarity, reciprocity, democratic operation, and a local circular economy.

Governance

We operate autonomously from government and public institutions, ensuring transparent decision-making and stakeholder participation.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.html:
Urban Community Center (UCC) complies with the 「Personal Information Protection Act」 and protects the personal information of its users. The following is a standard template and requires legal review before actual implementation.

1. Items of Personal Information Collected

We may collect names, email addresses, and contact information during membership registration or inquiries, and access logs may be automatically generated and collected during the use of our services.

2. Purpose of Collection and Use of Personal Information

Information is used for member management, responding to inquiries, providing and improving services, and fulfilling legal obligations.

3. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information

In principle, personal information is destroyed without delay once the purpose of collection and use has been achieved; however, it will be retained for the required period if preservation is necessary under relevant laws and regulations.

4. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties

In principle, the organization does not provide users' personal information to external parties and only does so when there is a legal basis for such provision.

5. Rights of Users

Users may request access to, correction of, deletion of, or suspension of the processing of their personal information at any time.

6. Personal Information Protection Officer

Personal Information Protection Officer: To be determined / Inquiries: contact@ucc.or.kr

rdc.title: Regional Innovation and Development Expert Course
rdc.html:
We train Regional Development Consultants (RDC), field experts who design and implement regional recovery from diagnosis to self-reliance.

Program Overview

Through a Living Lab-based step-by-step learning system, participants cultivate practical skills to investigate regional resources, define problems, design and verify standard programs, and lead initiatives until the community achieves self-reliance and transition.

Target Audience

  • Resident leaders and community activists
  • Policy officers from local governments and public institutions
  • Professionals in regional innovation and social economy

Key Curriculum

1. Regional Diagnosis & Resilience

Diagnosis of population, economy, and community; concepts and indicators of resilience

2. Living Lab Methodology

Resident-participatory problem solving, design and operation of field experiments

3. Resource Investigation & Problem Definition

Regional resource mapping, stakeholder analysis, and task identification

4. Standard Program Design

Application of regional recovery standard systems and pilot operations

5. Self-reliance & Transition

Establishment of operating models and governance, performance management, and transition

6. Completion & Networking

Project presentation, program completion, and connection to the RDC expert network

Post-Completion Opportunities

  • Regional Development Consultant (RDC) / Community Coordinator
  • Planning and operation of regional regeneration and community projects
  • Policy advisory and Living Lab facilitation

Please check the annual training schedule for detailed dates and the application page to register. ※ The curriculum is subject to change based on operational circumstances.
